title: Bayesian Learning to Select Fair Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2610.20514v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluations of classifiers (AI or human or agents) often assume a batch setting in which every agent produces labels on every example in a test set, which can be expensive or impractical in many contexts. This motivates online policies that adaptively select agents to query as examples arrive and update policies as outcomes are observed. We study the problem of selecting, in an online stream, the agent that best balances (i) predictive performance and (ii) subgroup fairness of a sensitive attribute, and that allows for delayed observations of true class labels. We formulate this as a Bayesian multi-armed bandit problem using Thompson Sampling, explicitly balancing accuracy and fairness. We conduct empirical evaluations on real-world datasets spanning problems involving tabular classifiers, large language models, and human labelers, demonstrating substantial reductions in regret relative to baselines. translated_title: 贝叶斯学习选择公平分类器
translated_abstract: 对分类器（无论是AI、人类还是智能体）的评估通常假设批量设置，即每个智能体需要对测试集中的每个样本都产生标签，这在许多场景下成本高昂或不切实际。这促使人们研究在线策略，即在样本到来时自适应地选择要查询的智能体，并在观察到结果后更新策略。我们研究了在在线数据流中选择智能体的问题，该智能体需最佳地平衡（i）预测性能与（ii）敏感属性的子群体公平性，同时允许真实类别标签的延迟观测。我们将该问题建模为基于汤普森采样的贝叶斯多臂老虎机问题，显式地平衡准确性与公平性。我们在涵盖表格分类器、大语言模型和人工标注者的真实世界数据集上进行了实证评估，结果表明相对于基线方法遗憾值显著降低。我们的理论贡献包括……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于汤普森采样的贝叶斯多臂老虎机在线方法，在真实标签延迟可得的条件下，自适应选择同时兼顾预测准确性与敏感属性子群体公平性的分类器（涵盖表格模型、大语言模型与人工标注者），并相比基线方法显著降低了遗憾值。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Thompson-sampling-based Bayesian multi-armed bandit method that adaptively selects classifiers balancing predictive accuracy and subgroup fairness in an online stream with delayed label feedback, achieving substantially lower regret than baselines across tabular classifiers, LLMs, and human labelers.
